2. The petitioner hereof, though not a party in Title Suit No. 118of 1998 and thus not being a judgment debtor, has been impleaded in the Title Execution Case No. 02 of 2005 pending before the Joint District Judge, First Court Sirajgonj, as judgment debtor No. 3 illegally and in the said TTT Execution Case the joint property belonging to Mr. Moslehuddin Ahmed, Managing Director of the judgment debtor Company in Title Suit No.l18 of 1998 and the petitioner Mohiuddin Ahmed has been included in the schedule for the purpose of satisfaction of the decree through auction sale thereof although neither, said Mr. Moslehuddin Ahmed nor the petitioner Mohiuddin Ahmed, in person, were made party in the Title Suit No. 118 of 1998 and the said suit has been decreed against the company Messrs Star Syntex Limited, which was the sole defendant in the suit and that as such the petitioner 'raised objection against Action sale of the joint property, detailed in the schedule of the Execution Case, and that the application has been rejected on the ground, amongst others, that the petitioner did not submit any paper or document in support of his claim in the property. 

 3. The learned Advocate appearing for the petitioner submits that the Court erred in law ; in not making any investigation as to the claim of the petitioner that he has been named in the Execution case as judgment debtor No.3 though he is not a judgment debtor and that the schedule land detailed in the Execution Case do not belong to the Judgment debtor. The learned Advocate could not satisfy us support of the claim that the petitioner produced documents before the Court below in support of title in the schedule land. The certified copy of the Decree passed in Title Suit No; 118 of 1998 by the Joint District Judge, 3rd Court, Dhaka, has been annexed to the application, which shows that M/S Micro Industries Development Assistance and Services (MIDAS) of House No. 5, Road No. 16 (New) Dhanmondi R/A. Dhaka- 1209 is the plaintiff and M/S Star Syntex Limited, of 592(A)/C, Khilgaon Chowdhury Para, Dhaka- 1219 is the defendant and the case relates to an award dated 12.05.98 in between the said parties. The certified copy of the award, which has been made rule of the Court, has been annexed, wherein the names of the parties have been mentioned as M/S Micro Industries Development Assistance and Services (MIDAS) of House No.5 Road No. 16 (New). Dhanmondi R/A Dhaka-1209 and M/S Star Syntex Limited, of 592 (A)/C, Khilgaon Chowdhury Para, Dhaka- 1219. Thus it appears that neither in the Decree nor in the Award the name of the petitioner has been mentioned and therefore it appears that the petitioner was not a party either in the Award or in the Rule of the Court and hence the inclusion of the name of the petitioner as judgment debtor No. 3 in the Execution Case No. 02 of 2005 is illegal and without lawful authority as well as is without any order of the Court. Thus it appears from the impugned order that the Court did not consider this aspect of the fact and thds acted illegally in passing the impugned order.
